name: ficheproduct
description: Génération de fiches produits assistée par IA

scripts.devTest: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run generate:types && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.generate:types: openapi-typescript openapi/api.yaml -o backend/src/generated/api.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/api.yaml -o frontend/src/generated/api.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/api.yaml -o frontend-test/src/generated/api.ts
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
